notes:
Operators: site:  inurl:  intitle:  intext:  filetype:/ext:  cache:  related:  AND/OR/NOT/-  ..range
Login pages: site:example.com (inurl:login OR inurl:admin)
Exposed files: site:example.com filetype:pdf  |  (filetype:xls OR filetype:docx)
Config files: site:example.com inurl:config.php  |  (ext:conf OR ext:cnf)
Backups: site:example.com inurl:backup  |  filetype:sql
More: Google Hacking Database (exploit-db.com/google-hacking-database). Google dorking uses advanced search operators to find sensitive content indexed by search engines. Key operators: site: (restrict to domain), inurl: (URL contains), filetype:/ext: (file type), intitle: (page title), intext: (body text), cache: (cached version), - (exclude). Combine operators for precise targeting. Also covered in: CPTS Ch05 (Information Gathering – Web Edition).
